task: Open “Use cases” from keyboard focus or with Arrow Down and follow “Blog readers”. Confirm the public destination /follow/lifestyle-blogs.
controlTask: Hover “Use cases”, click “Blog readers” and confirm /follow/lifestyle-blogs.

journey.selector: #navbarSupportedContent > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > a

barrier: Keyboard focus reaches “Use cases”, but Arrow Down leaves its panel hidden and clipped. Pointer hover applies the panel’s show class and makes “Blog readers” available.
